applies_to: EBTRON IAQ-N100 wall-mount sensors measuring CO2.
summary: The IAQ-N100 is an EBTRON wall-mount room sensor for CO2 with an RS-485 port that runs BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU when set by DIP switch). Its BACnet objects are a few Analog Inputs for the measurements plus Analog and Binary Values for elevation, sampling, baud rate and calibration.
notes: Points from Tables A2, A3-1 and A4 of the guide, which covers the IAQ-N100, IAQ-N200 and IAQ-N300 together.
The AV and BV objects are calibration and setup values, not control points.
Units are not printed per object; they are taken from the range and description columns.
The 24-hour lowest-CO2 value relies on the sensor clock; send a BACnet TimeSynchronization after every power loss.

source.title: IAQ-Ny00-W Quick Installation Guide - Wall Mount Indoor Air Quality Sensors with RS-485 Network Output (Appendix A)

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP MAC address and baud rate on DIP switch SW1 before power-up, then read the measurement AIs. The AVs and BVs are only for calibration and setup.
setup: MAC address defaults to 2; set 0-127 on SW1 switches 1-7 with power off.
Device instance defaults to 2; DIP switch 8 on at power-up copies the MAC address into the instance, or write the Device Object_Identifier.
MS/TP baud defaults to 76,800; 38,400, 19,200 or 9,600 can be set on SW1 switches 1-4 or through the Baud Rate AV.
gotchas: Send a BACnet time sync after any power loss; the 24-hour lowest-CO2 value depends on the sensor clock.
CO2 calibration should only be done between 400 and 2,000 ppm.
Writing gain/offset values changes the reading; the factory Gain/Offset Status BVs switch back to factory calibration.

points.name: Lowest PPM
points.description: Lowest CO2 in the past 24 h; any write resets it

points.name: Single Point PPM
points.description: Single-point CO2 calibration value; -1/-2/-3 report the result

points.name: ABC Logic Status
points.description: ABC automatic background calibration, 1 = on, 0 = off

points.name: CO2 Gain
points.description: Gain applied to the raw CO2 reading (default 1)

points.name: CO2 Offset
points.description: Offset applied to the raw CO2 reading (default 0)

points.name: Factory CO2 Gain/Offset Status
points.description: Active = use the factory CO2 gain/offset calibration
